ctx.x: Well, you had the Curly Hamilton, you had the masseur, Harrison, and you had the valey, Leroy, and they were the cream of the crop as far as Hamp. Hamp had a permit to carry a pistol, and Leroy carried it for him, you know, and they all had their thing going, (inaudible) and it just got to be a gangster band instead of friendly, and that was too much for me, and I didn't want any more of it.
I really didn't, because you can't play happy under these circumstances.
